name: MM-Eval
description: MM-Eval is a multilingual meta-evaluation benchmark designed to assess the reliability of evaluator LLMs in judging outputs from multilingual LLMs. It covers 18 languages in five core subsets and a Language Consistency subset spanning 122 languages, focusing on ranking accuracy, consistency, and fairness across languages.
reputation: A recent multilingual meta-evaluation benchmark that is increasingly relevant for assessing evaluator LLMs, though it is still early in adoption.
notes: Designed with multilingual-specific challenges; evaluates ranking accuracy, consistency, and fairness; covers low-resource languages.
